story:
Joshua and God's people march around Jericho as God says, and the walls fall down. Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end. (Joshua 6)

Memory line: Trust God and do what He says!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: What did the people blow? (Trumpets!)
Ages 4-8: What did God tell Joshua to do? Why was it hard to wait? When do we need to trust God?
Prayer: Dear God, help us trust You and do what You say, even when it is hard to wait. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Build a block wall, march around it seven times with a paper trumpet, then shout and let it tumble.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Big tall walls and gates shut tight
Joshua said, "God will make it right"
Marching round with trumpets blowing
Trusting God and keep on going

[Chorus]
March, march, march around the wall
God will help us, big or small
Trumpets blow and people sing
Trust in God, He's the King!

[Verse 2]
One time round for six whole days
Quiet feet and thankful praise
Seventh day, we march some more
Seven times, then hear the roar

[Chorus]
March, march, march around the wall
God will help us, big or small
Trumpets blow and people sing
Trust in God, He's the King!

[Verse 3]
Shout, shout, shout so loud and clear
Walls come tumbling, God is near
Waiting hard but we obey
God keeps every word He'll say

[Chorus - lifted]
March, march, march around the wall
God will help us, big or small
Trumpets blow and people sing
Trust in God, He's the King!

[Outro]
March, march, march!
Trust in God!

#BibleStoriesForKids #Eliora
